main_reference: Current user Plane233 C01, actually viewed; true open-L boundary lengths paired red/blue, no source partition. Migrated to detached span annotations to preserve the physical-paper interpretation.
migration_groups: The full three-cell left board side is the receiver for the three-cell long side of B after a quarter-turn.
The U-piece B has a genuine three-cell top side; compare its rotated orientation with the full board height.
The first two cells of the bottom board boundary supply the perpendicular two-cell width after rotating B.
B has a genuine two-cell left side. Together with its red top, this maps to a 2 by 3 vertical lane in the board without drawing any lane partition.
historical_difference: No historical tested Plane218 design existed. The current p01 four-long/two-high C bounding-span hypothesis produced complete B,C finals against preset C and is permanently excluded. This proposal uses a different 3 by 2 concave U, red/blue axes exchanged through an explicit quarter-turn comparison and the relative orientation of its open mouths. It is not a recolor, width change or rerun of p01.
limitation: Detachment is a deliberate adaptation needed by the physical-piece semantics. It is subject to parent independent review.
